recipe.description: Rook original art direction: strong compact head, broad chin and jaw, flatter broad cheek plane, projecting nose, slightly hooded eyelid fold and broader neutral mouth, and substantial neck matched to the shoulders. Numeric source labels are graphical controls, not biography. Seeded palette remains independent.

source_indices: All source vertex/UV/face/triangle indices are zero based. Face IDs count every OBJ f line. Triangle IDs count every original face fan triangle, including discarded body regions and helper groups.
lod: Original retained face topology is shared. No simplification or detail-destroying decimation is applied.
